answer: Simultaneous-ceremony bond stops mass fakes: each locks 70 credits; a falcon herald then releases the nonce for a ten-minute window. Inside it each files live proof sealed with a yarrow stamp binding key, nonce, and work. Late or stale proofs mark an identity hollow and burn its bond; two sharing one key burn both. First fake 42, k-th 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep bond and share.
